Job Requisition ID #

26WD94957

Position Overview 

At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. 

Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. 

Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. 

The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. 

Responsibilities 

  • API Design & Evolution: Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. 

  • System Architecture: Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. 

  • Schema Design & Evolution: Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. 

  • Standards & Governance: Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. 

  • Prototyping & Feasibility: Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. 

  • Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. 

  • Reliability & Performance: Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). 

  • Communication: Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. 

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 

  • 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. 

  • Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). 

  • Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. 

  • Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. 

  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. 

  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. 

  • Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. 

  • Ability to collaborate with a global team. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. 

Core: 

  • Cloud Services: AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). 

  • Distributed Systems: Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. 

  • API & Service Design: REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). 

  • Database Architecture: Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). 

  • Observability/SRE: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. 

Bonus: 

  • Semantic Technologies: Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. 

  • BIM Expertise: Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. 

  • AI Systems: RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). 

  • Domain-Specific AI for AEC: BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. 

  • Event-Driven Architectures: Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. 

  • AEC Domain Knowledge: Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. 

About the Team 

The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. 

Why Join Us 

  • Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. 

  • Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. 

  • Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio. 

  • Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry. 

  • Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning. 

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI. Our business value and leadership have been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.

We are looking for an Ontology Architect to lead high-impact applied Engineering and analytics initiatives. This role combines deep technical expertise, strong experimentation rigor, and business leadership to influence product direction and drive measurable outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities:

    • Ontology & Taxonomy Design: Lead the creation, modeling, and evolution of enterprise-wide ontologies, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies that accurately represent complex business domains.
    • Knowledge Graph Architecture: Design and implement scalable architecture, ingestion pipelines, and governance for enterprise Knowledge Graphs (Triple Stores or Property Graphs).
    • Semantic Layer Strategy: Build and maintain the enterprise semantic layer to abstract physical data complexities, providing a unified, machine-readable business view of data.
    • Data Product Augmentation: Partner with domain data teams to map, link, and augment decentralized Data Products using the central ontology to ensure semantic interoperability across the organization.
    • Inference & Reasoning: Implement semantic reasoning and inference rules to automatically generate new metadata and uncover hidden insights within the graph.
    • Governance & Standards: Establish best practices, version control mechanisms, and data contracts for semantic models, ensuring consistent graph schema updates across business units.

Requirements

  • Semantic Standards: Expert-level mastery of core semantic technologies
  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Hands-on experience designing and operating production-grade Graph Databases / Triple Stores (e.g., GraphDB, Stardog, Amazon Neptune, AllegroGraph, or Neo4j).
  • Ontology Modeling Tools: Proficiency with industry-standard ontology engineering and taxonomy management software (e.g., Protégé, TopBraid Composer, PoolParty).
  • Modern Data Frameworks: Clear, practical understanding of Data Mesh paradigms, specifically how to design a semantic layer that overlays federated, domain-driven Data Products.
  • Traditional Data Modeling: Strong baseline in classic data concepts, including relational databases, dimensional modeling, and ETL/ELT integration patterns.

Preferred Skills

  • Data Quality & Validation: Hands-on experience to enforce data quality and constraint validation across graph structures.
  • Advanced AI & Graph Analytics: Familiarity with graph algorithms, graph machine learning (GNNs), or leveraging Knowledge Graphs to enhance Large Language Model architectures via Graph RAG (Retrieval-Aug Generation).

Benefits

Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility.

Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

Ajax Systems ist ein internationales Technologieunternehmen und der größte Hersteller von Sicherheitssystemen in Europa mit über 4,5 Millionen Endnutzern und 330.000 PRO-Nutzern in mehr als 180 Ländern weltweit. Das Unternehmen bietet End-to-End-Lösungen zum Schutz von Wohn- und Geschäftsobjekten jeder Größenordnung. Bis heute umfasst das Produktportfolio von Ajax 280 Geräte für Einbruchschutz, Videoüberwachung, Brand- und Lebenssicherheit sowie Komfort- und Automatisierungslösungen. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt 5.000 Spezialisten.

Wir bauen lokale Teams auf, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass lokale Experten die Besonderheiten ihres Marktes am besten verstehen. Ajax Systems ist weltweit mit Vertriebsmitarbeitern vertreten, unter anderem in Norwegen, Schweden, Dänemark, Finnland, Italien, Spanien, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, den USA, Australien, Südafrika und weiteren Regionen. Das globale Business-Development-Team vereint Gleichgesinnte, die die ambitionierten Ziele von Ajax Systems teilen.

Die Kombination aus erstklassiger Software und leistungsstarker Hardware hat die Wahrnehmung von Sicherheitssystemen für Anwender und Branchenexperten nachhaltig verändert. Durch Anerkennungen auf den größten Fachmessen wie IFSEC, Expoprotection und Intersec sowie durch den Gewinn renommierter Auszeichnungen führender Branchenmedien wie dem PSI Magazine und GIT SECURITY zählt Ajax heute zu den meistausgezeichneten Sicherheitssystemen Europas.

Die Produktion von Ajax Systems umfasst vier Fabriken, davon zwei in der Ukraine, eine in der Türkei und eine in Vietnam. Gleichzeitig gewährleistet die ISO-14001-Zertifizierung des Unternehmens eine minimale Umweltbelastung durch die Produktion. Die Auswahl der Komponenten für die Herstellung der Ajax-Geräte basiert auf Herstellererklärungen, die die Einhaltung der RoHS-Richtlinien bestätigen.

Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und arbeiten Sie an Europas Sicherheitssystem mit den meisten Auszeichnungen mit!

Voraussetzungen und Anforderungen an einen Regional Business Development Manager:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektronischer Sicherheitssysteme (z. B. Intrusion, Video, Zutritt, Brand)
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder in der Unternehmensentwicklung in einem vertikalen B2B-Markt.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau (in Wort und Schrift).
  • Ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung für die eigenen Ergebnisse.
  • Verhandlungsgeschick: starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowohl am Telefon als auch im persönlichen Gespräch.
  • Hoch motiviert mit der Fähigkeit, Dinge zu verwirklichen.
  • Professionelles Auftreten, zuverlässiges und ethisches Verhalten.

Der Business Development Manager von Ajax Systems soll daher als Botschafter des Unternehmens und der Marke fungieren und die folgenden Aufgaben erfüllen:

  • Werbung für die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Ajax Systems bei Systemintegratoren, Errichtern, Fachberatern und Endverbrauchern (Geschäftspartnern) in Deutschland.
  • Erkundung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Organisation von Treffen mit Geschäftspartnern.
  • Planung und Vorbereitung von Präsentationen für Geschäftspartner und andere interessierte Personengruppen.
  • Aufbau und Erhaltung von Beziehungen zu Kooperationspartnern und Leitstellen.
  • Kommunikation von Produktfunktionen, Vorteilen und Entwicklungen an Geschäftspartner.
  • Durchführung von Produkt- und Handelsschulungen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Geschäftspartnern.
  • Aktive Förderung der Spezifikation von Systemen, die Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems enthalten.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebspartnern von Markenprodukten, um die Anforderungen der Geschäftspartner zu erfüllen.
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Marktstrategien für Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems.
  • Rückmeldung an das Management über die Anforderungen an aktuelle und zukünftige Produkte und Lösungen von Ajax Systems.
  • Erstellen von genauen und zeitnahen Berichten unter Verwendung des CRM-Systems des Unternehmens zur Unterstützung der eigenen Aufgaben oder entsprechend den Anforderungen des Managements.

Wir bieten:

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Löhne - und ein transparentes Motivationssystem;
  • Ein Produkt, das sich selbst verkauft;
  • Bezahlung von Schulungen und Konferenzen, die wir für unsere Mitarbeiter durchführen;
  • Ein starkes, gut eingespieltes Team von Fachleuten;
  • Firmenwagen und alle Geschäftskosten abgedeckt.

Compensation

Additional Information

Wir arbeiten dafür, dass das Leben der Menschen friedlich und die Welt sicher ist. Werden Sie Teil des Teams, das ein intelligentes und sinnvolles globales Produkt herstellt.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. You will be selling over zoom and not in person.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.
  • Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles.
  • Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 1+ years of experience in a closing sales role

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

  • Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
  • Five-time Top Workplace USA winner
  • Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace
  • Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

NetDocuments is seeking a Director, Product & Segment Marketing to lead and scale our product marketing function across all key customer segments: Strategic (AM Law 200) law firms, Large law firms, Midsize law firms, Small law firms, and Corporate Legal departments. This role reports to the VP of Product Marketing and is responsible for developing and directing all product and segment marketing activities — from go-to-market strategy and competitive positioning to segment-specific messaging, sales enablement, and market intelligence.

This is a leadership role that sits at the intersection of product marketing and segment marketing. You will build deep expertise in how each customer segment evaluates, buys, and adopts legal technology — and translate that understanding into differentiated go-to-market strategies that drive growth. The ideal candidate brings a blend of product marketing rigor and segment or industry marketing experience, with the ability to develop and motivate a team of product marketers.

Whether your background is in product marketing, segment marketing, industry marketing, or solutions marketing within enterprise software, we want to hear from you.

  • Segment Strategy & Go-to-Market: Define and execute differentiated go-to-market strategies for each customer segment — Strategic (AM Law 200), Large, Midsize, and Small law firms, and Corporate Legal. Tailor positioning, pricing narratives, competitive plays, and launch plans to the distinct buying behaviors, decision-makers, and adoption patterns within each segment
  • Product Messaging & Positioning: Own the creation of value propositions, messaging frameworks, positioning statements, and thought leadership for NetDocuments’ product portfolio — including the legal context graph, ndMAX AI, Smart Answers, document automation, security, and collaboration solutions — aligned to segment-specific buyer personas and use cases
  • Market Research & Segment Intelligence: Understand, monitor, and analyze the overall legal technology market, unique dynamics of each segment, product/market fit of our solutions, key buyer personas, and emerging trends. Develop a clear voice of the customer for internal stakeholders through research, customer advisory boards, and field feedback
  • Competitive Intelligence: Lead competitive intelligence efforts across all segments. Identify and monitor top competitors, conduct win-loss analyses, share findings with product teams and executives, develop competitive positioning, and incorporate insights into sales enablement, marketing programs, and collateral
  • Sales Enablement: Support the sales organization by communicating segment-specific value through the development of briefing documents, battle cards, training presentations, pitch decks, case studies, sales plays, and other tools. Ensure sales teams are equipped to engage each segment with relevant messaging and proof points
  • Product Launches: Drive launch and go-to-market strategies in close collaboration with product management, sales, content, demand generation, and other teams. Manage internal readiness, develop external launch plans, and coordinate cross-functional execution to ensure successful launches across all segments
  • Marketing Content & Campaigns: Assist the marketing team with segment-relevant messaging in core collateral such as web copy, brochures, videos, presentations, webinars, events (including Inspire), eBooks, and infographics. Partner on marketing plan execution from branding through demand generation
  • Analyst & Industry Relations: Work with industry analysts, associations, and influencers to position NetDocuments as the category leader across all customer segments
  • Team Leadership: Guide, mentor, and develop a team of product marketers. Build a data-driven, high-performance culture focused on achieving quantifiable outcomes and professional growth

What You Will Bring to the Team

  • Strong leadership and management skills with the ability to develop and motivate individuals to their full potential
  • Passion for understanding distinct customer segments and tailoring strategy to each — from strategic AM Law 200 firms to small firms and corporate legal departments
  • Strong messaging voice with a talent for highlighting key points of differentiation that resonate across different buyer profiles and market segments
  • Expertise coordinating across marketing, sales, customer excellence, and product management
  • Ability to understand commercial, technological, and strategic drivers and build multi-year marketing strategies
  • Building a data-driven environment focused on achieving quantifiable outcomes
  • Strategic and critical thinking with the ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative market feedback
  • Organizational and project management proficiency
  • Attention to detail and strong presentation skills
  • Adaptability to the styles and needs of different stakeholders — sales, product, marketing, and executive leadership

What You Will Need for Success

Required:

  • Marketing experience with Legal Technology
  • 7+ years of experience in product marketing, segment marketing, industry marketing, or solutions marketing within enterprise or B2B SaaS software
  • 3+ years of experience managing or leading marketing teams
  • Proven track record of developing and executing go-to-market strategies across multiple customer segments or verticals
  • Demonstrated ability to set annual and quarterly plans, prioritize team projects, and drive execution
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field

Preferred:

  • Experience working with attorneys, law firms (including AM Law 200/large firms), corporate legal departments, and/or public sector organizations
  • Experience marketing AI-powered, data-driven, or cloud platform products
  • Understanding of the legal technology landscape (document management, eDiscovery, compliance, legal operations, AI for legal)
  • Experience working with government and public sector markets
  • MBA or JD preferred

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.

As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You’ll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM’s and containers.

As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you’re able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

The role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team’s goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders

An overview of this role

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Duo Chat team, focused on Chat Engine, you'll build the core AI capabilities behind GitLab Duo Chat, the natural-language and agentic interface to the GitLab DevSecOps platform. Much of your work will involve building flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry, the Python framework built on LangGraph within our Duo Workflow Service that powers agentic chat, and integrating them with the GitLab Rails monolith.

You'll own complex backend features from start to finish across both services. You'll integrate large language models and orchestrate multi-agent flows so customers can work faster and more securely across the software development lifecycle. This work sits where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy, and reliability, performance, and answer quality directly shape the customer experience.

What you’ll do

  • Design and build flow components and agentic flows in the Flow Registry using Python and LangGraph within the Duo Workflow Service. These reusable building blocks power agentic Duo Chat and, increasingly, other AI features across GitLab.
  • Develop, ship, and maintain backend features for GitLab Duo Chat across the Python Duo Workflow Service and the GitLab Rails monolith in a secure, well-tested, and performant way.
  • Integrate new generative AI models, providers, tools, and multi-agent orchestration patterns into Duo Chat to expand its capabilities and improve answer quality.
  • Design, implement, and review GraphQL and Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs) and related monolith logic, including chat entry points, permissions, and foundational-flow registration. Keep contracts with frontend clients and host systems reliable and clear.
  • Improve debugging, observability, and test coverage using pytest, RSpec, and related frameworks; track and improve latency, error rates, and test coverage so AI-powered chat workflows stay reliable at scale.
  • Collaborate with Product, User Experience (UX), frontend, and AI specialists to refine requirements and deliver high-quality improvements through iteration.
  • Document standards, patterns, and learnings with other engineers, raising the bar for safe AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.
  • Participate in Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and strengthen resiliency.

  • Proficiency designing or extending REST or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability, and backward compatibility.
  • Strong Structured Query Language (SQL) skills and familiarity with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including efficient queries and data modeling.
  • Ability to find, diagnose, and prevent performance and reliability problems at scale.
  • Experience solving technical problems of high scope and complexity and advocating for quality, security, and performance improvements across your team.
  • Openness to learning and collaborating in an async-first, distributed team, applying transferable skills from related technologies or domains. Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain is a strong plus.
